correctness.rationale: For V=F2^4 the pairing gives exactly 15 isotropic 2-subspaces and 60 cosets. The quadratic refinement is affine on every isotropic coset, proving inclusion in six-congruence kernel. The resulting moment homomorphism onto Z/4 x (Z/2)^5 is surjective by five independent explicit basis differences; kernel index is 128. One explicitly enumerated 16-column incidence minor has exact determinant -128, so the inclusion is equality. A standalone stdlib Bareiss program reconstructed both sides and reproduced determinant, mod2 rank10, and counts.

value.rationale: The Göpel 60-tetrad family is a canonical symmetric node configuration used in Kummer geometry. This complete integral membership test is not a trivial rank or renaming: it reveals a degree-four integrality obstruction and five independent binary symplectic moment constraints, and gives an exact classification of the natural incidence sublattice. Such integer data are invisible in the classical cardinality 60 and rational rank16 alone, making the result a motivated self-contained structural invariant. It does not claim a larger K3 Picard-lattice consequence.
